title: Hours Added Back for an Equipment-Fault Swap — PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Hours Added Back for an Equipment-Fault Swap — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Credit note.** Hours lost to an equipment fault are added back to the average daily use stated on a PAP Therapy Equipment usage summary:

- a record whose **latest malfunction swap** was made by an **in-home visit** adds **0.2 hours**;
- a record with a swap made **any other way** adds **0.1 hours**;
- a record without a swap adds nothing.

The hours are added to the average as it stands, before the stated figure is rounded.

**Where it is read.** A malfunction swap is a delivery in the device's service history whose purpose is a malfunction swap; how it was made is that delivery's mode — in-home setup, branch setup, virtual setup or courier. Where several swaps are recorded, the latest one decides.

| Malfunction swap on the record | Mode of the latest swap | Hours added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | in-home setup | 0.2 |
| yes | branch setup, virtual setup or courier | 0.1 |
| no | — | 0.0 |

**Case (hypothetical).** One swap, made by courier, on a record averaging 3.85 hours: 0.1 is added to 3.85, giving 3.95 before rounding.
